description: The Visible and Infrared Spin Scan Radiometer (VISSR) on FY-2C is an optical and infrared imaging radiometer observing from geostationary orbit. It provides one visible and four infrared channels (split-window thermal infrared, water vapour, and mid-infrared) to monitor clouds, storms, and atmospheric moisture.
facility_description: FengYun-2C is an operational first-generation geostationary meteorological satellite of China, launched in October 2004 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
